top_signals.title: Fed’s preferred gauge showed core inflation at 3.0% in August, much lighter than expected
top_signals.summary: The personal consumption expenditures price index was projected to show an annual gain of 3.7% on headline and 3.3% for core, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Passengers Avert Crash Tackling Pilot Who Stabbed Colleague
top_signals.summary: A pilot of a jet carrying more than 170 passengers to Tel Aviv stabbed his colleague and tried to crash the plane in what Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu branded a serious security incident. Catastrophe was narrowly avoided after a passenger and members of crew stormed the cockpit of the FlyDubai plane that had taken off in Dubai and managed to stabilize the jet, after it plunged more than 14,000 feet (4,300 meters) in less than 30 seconds at almost the speed of sound. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Formally Concludes Operation Inherent Resolve in Iraq
top_signals.summary: The US has formally concluded Operation Inherent Resolve in Iraq with the departure of coalition forces and equipment, according to a Pentagon statement. Lt. General Karen Gibson (Retired), Former-Deputy Director of National Intelligence joined to discuss this as well as the latest in the Middle East.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Komeito selects former party policy chief Okamoto as new leader
top_signals.summary: Komeito is rushing to rebuild its organization ahead of an extraordinary Diet session beginning next week.
